column1: # The slow-gate scan's committed corpus: TestSlowGateScanCorpus reads every row.
# tree:    a fixture root beside this file (its Makefile and its Go packages).
# check:   static  the unarmed-line audit; subject is the tree's one recipe
#                  target, want the scan's exit code (1 refused, 0 proven).
#          credit  the coverage accounting; subject is pkg.Test, want the make
#                  target credited with running it, - for none.
# F-030: -race builds under the race tag, so a test behind //go:build !race is
# not built; an unarmed line that selects only it runs no tests, and an armed
# race line is not credited with it.
# F-219: go test rewrites a space in a selector to _, so -skip 'TestWin Codec'
# removes TestWin_Codec; the line that skips it is not credited with it.
